{{Quote|Well, I'm going to ''grant'' your wishes. Here on ''Chenini''&mdash;one of Tatooine's barren moons...|[[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], to [[Sülphurr Cyander]]|<ref name="Spices & Spies">{{TCWComicCite|6.15|Spices & Spies}}</ref>}}
'''Chenini''' was a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It had a large, elliptical orbit which took it as far as four million miles away from Tatooine at apogee, causing it to be overlooked on many planetary surveys.

==History==
[[File:Chenini.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Surface of Chenini]]
The erratic appearance and disappearance of this celestial body led to many superstitions: [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] planned rituals around the moon's cycle, while [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] used the moons just before storm season to time their annual [[swap meet]]s.

{{Moon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[Wikipedia:Chenini|''Chenini'']] is also the name of a real village near [[Wikipedia:Tataouine|Tataouine]] in [[Tunisia]], where most Tatooine scenes were filmed.
